study: Further calibrations on the source lives at L = 12 (additional table; PPO + calibration in Section 4.1 and Appendix C)
description: The final source policies receive a calibrated cut on their ORDER probability; the projection Rule is recalibrated on a denser grid of 802 thresholds; a two-indicator rule chooses among 236,876 candidates; a privileged per-law rule knows the law of each life; failure-budget variants minimize unused life with at most 1% failures. All are fitted on 2,000 calibration lives and replayed on the 2,000 test lives of Table 2.
